settings.text:
Cleveland Golf, Srixon, XXIO, and Dunlop Racket Sports are a family of global brands dedicated to the joy of the game. We are Dunlop Sports, a house united under the iconic Flying D logo.

We love the game. It’s why we play. It’s that incredible feeling when all the practice comes together for your first eagle putt. Backhand crosscourt winner. Perfectly placed nick shot. Or jump smash for the championship.

Loving the game is what drives you to compete at your best. And what’s driven us to create state-of-the-art equipment for 130 years of athletes just like you.

settings.content: The preferred Drivers, Irons, and Balls of top-ranked players on the sport’s biggest tours, alongside earnest golfers the world over, Srixon produces premium, high-performance equipment for the game we all love.

An undisputed trailblazer and longtime Wedge design innovator, Cleveland Golf continues to create easy-to-hit Woods and Irons along with elite short-game equipment. Its gear helps tour players and recreational golfers alike shoot their lowest scores.

Experience the Difference of XXIO. Featuring ultralight golf clubs constructed of exotic materials using revolutionary technologies, XXIO is made to enhance the performance of moderate swing speed golfers.

Over the past 100 years, the iconic Dunlop brand helped transform sports like tennis and squash with revolutionary balls and rackets, and it continues to offer beautifully designed, technically sophisticated sports products and apparel to passionate players around the world.

settings.title: How long does it take to get my products?
settings.text:
Stock Product: 1-3 Business Days (excluding Canadian holidays)

Some orders may be delayed to ensure safety of our team members while building and shipping your clubs, but rest assured we’re working hard to delivery your order as soon as possible. 

Most shipments are going out in 2-4 days but can take up to 7-10 days from order placement. You’ll automatically receive ship confirmation and tracking information as soon as your order ships.

settings.title: Do you offer warranty for your products?
settings.text:
Cleveland Golf Canada Corp warrants its golf products to be free from defects in materials and workmanship for one year from the date of first retail sale if purchased from Cleveland Golf Canada Corp or a Cleveland Golf Canada Corp Authorized Reseller.

For more information, please visit our warranty page.

settings.title: Do you offer refunds?
settings.text:
Yes, we offer full and partial refunds.

Please enquire for more information about our Refund policy.

settings.title: How long does it take to get my custom club?
settings.text: All custom club builds take 2-4 business weeks for delivery.
